name: answer-buttons
description: Puts buttons under Claude's questions, which Claude tags "[Question]:" with an "Options:" line of numbered «quoted» options: one button per option (one or pick-any), Yes/No when none are listed, and Other for typed text; a rhetorical question gets none; a Submit button sends your answers at once, or they go with your next prompt; unanswered questions stay open across later replies until answered, dismissed or replaced
